students Back to Country Algeria Algeria At the University of Central Lancashire, we welcome students from Algeria and look forward to seeing you at our UK campus. Entry Requirements Our entry requirements can change depending on the course and the year you apply. The information below is just a guide. Even if you have, or are expected to get, the grades shown on our website, we cannot guarantee that you will receive an offer from the University of Lancashire. If your academic or English language qualifications are not enough to start a degree with us, you can join a foundation course at the University of Lancashire with ONCampus . If you complete this course successfully, you can move on to many of our undergraduate or postgraduate programmes. Please see our English Language requirements for further information and guidance. Entry requirements Minimum English language requirements Entry requirements Open all accordion items Foundation year Brevet de Technicien Superieur with grade of 10.00-11.99/20 Passable Undergraduate (Year 1) Brevet de Technicien Superieur with grade of 12.00-13.99 Assez Bien Postgraduate A score of 12/20 “Assez Bien” is accepted for the following qualifications: Licence (4 year programme) Diplome de [subject area] Diplome d’Etudes Superieures Diplome d’Ingenieur / Diplome d’Architecte d’Etat) Diplome d’Etudes Universitaires Appliquees Minimum English language requirements Open all accordion items Foundation year Standard English language entry requirements - IELTS 6.0 (with no component score lower than 5.5) or equivalent. Undergraduate (Year 1) Standard English language entry requirements - IELTS 6.0 (with no component score lower than 5.5) or equivalent. Postgraduate Standard English language entry requirements - IELTS 6.0 (with no component score lower than 5.5) or equivalent. Scholarships and bursaries We have a wide range of scholarships and bursaries available for international students. Please note that these scholarships are not available for postgraduate research, MBBS, online learning or pre-sessional programmes. Undergraduate Articulation Scholarship To celebrate our formal partnerships with key institutions worldwide, we are offering a scholarship of £2,000 per year to each student who progresses from one of our specified partner institutions (see list). Read more about Articulation Scholarship Country Group A Scholarship Our country scholarship is designed to support international students from selected countries. You must be both a national and a resident of these countries. Read more about Country Group A Scholarship Country Specific Bursary Our country-specific bursary is offered to all applicants who are nationals of and residents in specific countries. Read more about Country Specific Bursary Excellence Scholarship If applicants have achieved excellent grades prior to entering their chosen undergraduate or postgraduate taught programme with us, the Excellence Scholarship will be applied. Read more about Excellence Scholarship Family Loyalty Scholarship Our Family Loyalty Scholarship is available to the sibling, spouse or child of someone who is either currently studying on, or who has graduated from, a full-time course with us. Read more about Family Loyalty Scholarship Franchise Scholarship To celebrate our formal partnerships with key institutions worldwide, we are offering a scholarship of £2,000 per year to each student who progresses from one of our specified partner institutions (see list). Read more about Franchise Scholarship INTO Scholarship Celebrating our partnership with INTO University Partnerships, these awards are offered to applicants from any INTO study centre entering either their first or second year of undergraduate or postgraduate study at UCLan. Read more about INTO Scholarship International Bursary An international bursary is available to many international students enrolling with us. Read more about International Bursary MBBS Excellence Scholarship MBBS Excellence Scholarship is for international students in the top ten for demonstrating exceptional aptitude in our Multiple Mini Interview. Successful students will receive a fantastic £5000 reduction in international fees in Year 1 and Year 2 of their MBBS course. Read more about MBBS Excellence Scholarship Northern Consortium (NCUK) Scholarship In recognition of our partnership with the Northern Consortium (NCUK) we are delighted to offer an attractive scholarship to these students. Read more about Northern Consortium (NCUK) Scholarship OnCampus Scholarship In recognition of our partnership with ONCampus, we are delighted to offer an attractive scholarship to these students. Read more about OnCampus Scholarship Sports scholarships We offer student athletes support and opportunities for their playing careers whilst they study a high-quality degree. Read more about Sports scholarships The Medivet Hardship Fund The Medivet Hardship Fund is available to BVMS students to support essential one-off purchases or expenses incurred as part of their study. students Back to Country Angola Angola At the University of Central Lancashire, we welcome students from Angola. Proud winners of International Student Support of the Year at TINE Africa 2024 We have been awarded Best International Student Support 2024 in the TINE Africa Awards, following nominations in both 2023 and 2024. Find out more about our student support services Entry Requirements Our entry requirements can change depending on the course and the year you apply. The information below is just a guide. Even if you have, or are expected to get, the grades shown on our website, we cannot guarantee that you will receive an offer from the University of Lancashire. If your academic or English language qualifications are not enough to start a degree with us, you can join a foundation course at the University of Lancashire with ONCampus . If you complete this course successfully, you can move on to many of our undergraduate or postgraduate programmes. Please see our English Language requirements for further information and guidance. Entry requirements Minimum English language requirements Entry requirements Open all accordion items Foundation year Successful completion of a recognised international foundation programme Undergraduate (Year 1) Grau de Bacharel (CertHE) (14/20) OR: Grau de Bacharel (CertHE) (12/20) Postgraduate Grau de Mestre with a minimum grade of 13/20 and above Minimum English language requirements Open all accordion items Foundation year Standard English language entry requirements - IELTS 6.0 (with no component score lower than 5.5) or equivalent. Undergraduate (Year 1) Standard English language entry requirements - IELTS 6.0 (with no component score lower than 5.5) or equivalent. Postgraduate Standard English language entry requirements - IELTS 6.0 (with no component score lower than 5.5) or equivalent. We’re proud to be a truly international university, with a thriving staff and student community of 38,000+ people from over 100 countries. We encourage all our students to become ‘global citizens’ and our courses open doors to worldwide career opportunities. We offer a welcoming destination to all our international students, providing them with the support they need to succeed in their studies. Our 5 QS Stars also reflects the opportunities we provide to enable students to experience other cultures; the success of our overseas campus in Cyprus; and our 120+ international partnerships with universities based in China, Malaysia, the Far East and beyond.
